title: Coordination isomerism
basic_overview: Structural and stereoisomerism include ionisation, linkage, coordination, geometrical and optical forms.

extra_info_content.step_by_step: 1. Draw sphere. 2. Check counter-ion/ligand exchange. 3. Check ambidentate linkage. 4. Check cis/trans or fac/mer. 5. Test chirality.
extra_info_content.kinetics_or_energy: Compare thermodynamic driving force with kinetic barrier when relevant; do not treat a favourable ΔG° as proof of a fast reaction.
extra_info_content.exam_focus: cis/trans Pt, fac/mer Co, optical en complexes.
